2610.13644.title: SelectArena: A Modern Benchmark for Feature Selection on Real-world Tabular Data
2610.13644.paper_summary: Selecting a subset of features (columns) from a tabular dataset is a ubiquitous challenge in real-world applications. Industry experts seek to minimize model training costs, climate scientists require an interpretable subset of factors to understand extreme weather events, and clinicians need to choose among diagnostic tests due to financial and time constraints. When looking at the scientific literature to determine which feature selection method to use, practitioners across domains face an unrepresentative landscape of benchmarking. Despite extensive research, existing feature selection benchmarks provide limited guidance because they rely on outdated models, ad hoc evaluation protocols, or artificially generated data that do not reflect real-world problems. To close the gap between scientific benchmarking and real-world applications, we introduce SelectArena, a modern benchmark for feature selection. We compare 15 widely used feature selection methods on 71 manually curated real-world tabular datasets, covering classification and regression problems, using standardized evaluation protocols and state-of-the-art tabular (foundation) models. Our results reveal clear trade-offs across predictive performance, runtime, stability, and validity. Tree-based methods, CART and RFImportance, along with F-Test are Pareto-optimal when taking into account predictive performance and runtime. F-Test, information-theory-, and distance-based methods lead on stability and validity, with F-Test emerging as a balanced choice across our metrics. Search-based methods are slow, unstable and achieve low performance. SelectArena turns these findings into practical guidance and, as an extensible platform, supports future feature selection research.
2610.13644.paper_summary_zh: 選擇表格數據集中的特徵（列）子集是現實世界應用中的一個普遍挑戰。行業專家尋求最小化模型訓練成本，氣候科學家需要可解釋的因素子集以理解極端天氣事件，臨床醫生因財務和時間限制需要在診斷測試中進行選擇。在查看科學文獻以確定使用哪種特徵選擇方法時，各領域的從業者面臨著不具代表性的基準環境。儘管進行了廣泛的研究，現有的特徵選擇基準提供的指導有限，因為它們依賴於過時的模型、臨時的評估協議或不反映現實問題的人工生成數據。為了縮小科學基準與現實世界應用之間的差距，我們推出了SelectArena，一個現代化的特徵選擇基準。我們在71個手動策劃的現實世界表格數據集上比較了15種廣泛使用的特徵選擇方法，涵蓋分類和回歸問題，使用標準化的評估協議和最先進的表格（基礎）模型。我們的結果揭示了預測性能、運行時間、穩定性和有效性之間的明確權衡。基於樹的方法，CART和RFImportance，以及F-Test在考慮預測性能和運行時間時是Pareto最優的。F-Test、信息理論和基於距離的方法在穩定性和有效性上表現突出，F-Test在我們的指標中成為一個平衡的選擇。基於搜索的方法則較慢、不穩定且性能低下。SelectArena將這些發現轉化為實用指導，並作為一個可擴展的平台，支持未來的特徵選擇研究。
